issue.detail: Spec says capture 1->0 per bit; contract uses prev_in init 0, so first cycle with in=0 after reset release does not capture (prev=0). Alternative: treat first sampled cycle as no prior, also no capture — same. Distinguishing case: reset released with in=0 then in=1 then in=0.
issue.spec_evidence: capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next
issue.alternative: Initialize prev_in to the first sampled in value (no capture on first cycle) vs 0; differs when first cycle in=1 then second in=0: init-0 captures at cycle2 (prev=1), init-first also captures. Differs when first cycle in=0, second in=1, third in=0: both capture at cycle3. No difference. Alternative: capture only after at least two cycles; differs if first cycle in=1, second in=0: init-0 captures, delayed does not.
